blocks.text: Achhe hal aksar ek se zyada emerging technologies ko milate hain. AI ki zehanat, IoT ka rabta, Cloud ki scalability aur Blockchain ki hifazat mil kar taqatwar, data par mabni systems banati hain. Yeh milap aisi smart applications banata hai jo sirf masle hal nahi karti, balke waqt ke saath khud ko dhaal kar behtar bhi hoti hain.

Smart irrigation (pani dene ka) system IoT sensors se zameen ki nami nap sakta, AI algorithms se fasal ki pani ki zaroorat ka andaza laga sakta, aur Cloud storage mein data jama aur analyze kar sakta hai. Is se kisan pani behtar use karte, kharch kam karte aur paidawar barhate hain. Aise mile jule systems dikhate hain ke technologies ka ishtirak Pakistan mein paidar zaraat aur mahol ki hifazat mein kaise madad kar sakta hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Mile jule groups banayein (technology, social science, business). Mil kar aisa project design karein jo technology se kisi basti ka masla hal kare.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Integration ka matlab hai kai technologies ko jor dena. Smart irrigation mein: IoT sensor zameen ki nami napta hai, Cloud yeh data jama karta hai, aur AI andaza lagati hai ke fasal ko kitna pani chahiye. Teenon mil kar woh kaam karte hain jo akeli koi technology nahi kar sakti.
